name: graphon
description: Object storage with search your coding agent can set up, fill, query, and wire into your app.

interface.longDescription:
Graphon is object storage with search built in. It serves an
S3-compatible API, a JSON API, and search, answers, and research over
the files of a bucket.

This plugin gives your coding agent three things: the Graphon MCP server,
the Graphon CLI, and skills that teach the agent how to use them.

With the plugin installed, you can ask your agent to create a bucket,
upload files, search them, answer a question from them with citations,
add file uploads or a search box to your app, or move an existing bucket
into Graphon. The agent picks the right interface for each job: MCP tools
for control-plane work and questions, the CLI for local files and
secrets, and an SDK for the code it writes.

The agent signs in with OAuth on its first call. The plugin stores no key.
When your app needs a key, the agent puts it where your project keeps
its secrets, so the key never appears in the transcript.
defaultPrompt: Set up Graphon storage in this project.
Add search over my documents to this app.
Ask my Graphon bucket why checkout stalled last week.
